title: 批次原子追加：每个字节边界强杀与恢复
problem: batch.begin 与 batch.end 之间每个字节边界崩溃后，恢复是否完全无半批；自己的写者能截断，别人的残尾只忽略且字节哈希不变；fsync/Windows 文件锁的实际能力。
method: 独立 Node writer 写入目标批次前 N 字节并 fsync 后挂起，主 runner SIGKILL/taskkill 强杀；N 遍历 0..L，覆盖空文件与已有 seed 批次；随后另起同 segment 的独立 writer 进程截断残尾，再重放，并对他人残尾副本只读重放+哈希对比；另测文件/目录 fsync 与 wx 文件锁争用。
passCriteria: 所有注入点恢复后无半批，重放事件数符合预期
已提交 seed 批次在所有前缀注入下原样保留
他人 segment 残尾被只读重放忽略，SHA-256 前后不变
独立 writer 由 runner 强杀而非自行正常退出
文件 fsync 与协作文件锁有真实通过输出；不支持的目录 fsync 明确标注未验证

format.checksum: SHA-256 of concatenated raw event lines including newline
format.idNote: Spike IDs are deterministic labels; production uses ULID per architecture.

directory.note: Windows directory fsync unsupported/failed; do not claim power-loss durability

fileLock.note: wx/O_EXCL is a cooperative lock file; Node does not expose Windows mandatory byte-range locks

scenarios.name: empty-file
scenarios.description: 空 segment；注入 0..L 字节后强杀

scenarios.name: after-seed
scenarios.description: 已提交 seed 批次；再注入目标批次 0..L 字节后强杀

caveats: Directory fsync is not supported on this Windows/Node combination; power-loss durability is not proven by this spike.
File lock uses cooperative wx/O_EXCL lock-file creation; Node exposes no mandatory Windows byte-range lock API.
Each injected prefix was fsynced before SIGKILL so the byte boundary state is observable; this is the stronger persisted-prefix case.
Only a synthetic batch format and synthetic segment were tested; no production ledger code exists yet.
